checks.name: heterogeneous_source_preservation
checks.result: Explicit field/status mapping, source-vocabulary writeback, Chinese ADR metadata and conflict checks passed. An isolated copy probe retained all 20 source files byte-for-byte and indexed 48 work items plus 19 ADRs without unknown statuses.

checks.name: public_document_and_secret_boundaries
checks.result: Secret policy 3 gate passed 16/16 conditions across 9 core, 11 runtime and 3 CLI/MCP test functions. Public definitions remain usable through summary truncation; actual values, hidden defaults and duplicate-key concealment remain rejected.

checks.name: workspace_and_protocol_regression
checks.result: cargo test --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast --locked passed 321 tests across 80 suites, with 7 existing ignored entrypoints. CLI/MCP parity passed 8 tests. Doctor shares the indexed profile/options/parser-version identity and still detects actual configuration changes. Counts overlap with targeted checks.

checks.name: build_format_and_planning
checks.result: Workspace check, CLI/MCP build, format, diff whitespace and planning validation passed locally on Darwin arm64.

checks.name: source_and_remote_binding
checks.result: Remote branch and GitHub commit API both returned the recorded source SHA. Main current/scenarios/metrics/QA/release items match the preserved a222e32d8d3491d41d3a0e8dd0c5d5ed176f528b baseline.

acceptance.criterion: 支持可审阅的来源字段及状态映射，保留原始状态和来源；未知值保留诊断、配置冲突明确报错，接入无需重写原台账。
ADR 支持中文与英文元数据、列表格式和全角冒号，保留原文及来源；相互冲突声明不能静默覆盖。
不含凭据的认证说明与结构定义可以接入；标签下的实际值及形似凭据、伪装夹带和旧数据出口仍受到检测。
CLI 接入及复检覆盖异构台账和中文 ADR，并验证映射变更使缓存失效；doctor 与索引共享配置口径，定向回归和独立临时项目保留原文件。

limitations: Local programmatic integration evidence, not E4 or release acceptance; current native CI is tracked separately on PR 2.
Reference project files/runtime state were not modified; source-declared completion is not verified business delivery.
Mappings cover supported work fields; arbitrary root schema transforms and Markdown writeback are outside this change.
Secret detection does not claim complete recognition of arbitrary unlabelled private text.
Not merged and not published to npm or PyPI.
